appendOnly.note: every ingredient is already a W1 material or starter, so an append-only ladder adds no step; the recipe becomes discoverable at W1 step 12

scoring.assumption: equal skill: a sauce recipe with sauce=pieces=x vs a no-sauce recipe with pieces=x; recipe=100 (an exact-match discovery is always 100% present, purity 1) and bake=100; quantity factor 1

existing25Unchanged.why: every option is selected only when a recipe's Reference has no sauce (data-driven); all 25 runtime Reference fixtures carry a sauce, so their branch is byte-identical. Pinned by a golden test in TQ-1B.

classificationChecks.detail: 33 non-tomato-base rows; 21 need no capability at all, so a special sauce never requires a new gesture by itself (a second layer is DOUBLE_SPREAD, counted separately)
33 DOUGH_VARIANT rows; Phase-1 merge rationale: the evidence never changes the player's gesture for any dough variant (data-level dough base)
piadina requiredCapabilities=['DOUGH_VARIANT'], sauce=none: piadina itself is not a technique; it is DOUGH_VARIANT (material) × NO_SAUCE (technique)
serve-whole-no-cut rows ['calzone-pizzadb'] are all ENCLOSE rows; CUT is not an identity dimension (signature.ts); the only full-signature collision group (fugazza/fugazzetta) is not separated by CUT
every complete row with a late-addition ingredient (8 rows) still has pre-bake ingredients; no evidenced pizza is made only after the bake, so pre-bake placement is the baseline every row shares
12 rows need LATE_ADDITION on required-strength evidence; 11 rows carry it as candidate-only (repo inference) and are never counted as required (OD-TQ-12)
